name: Mortal Kombat X — Character Biographies
notes: Primary Mortal Kombat X character biographies preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. The mirror is access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Liu Kang, Kitana, and Kung Lao biographies explicitly state that after their deaths Quan Chi collected their souls, created revenant versions of them, and that they serve Quan Chi and the Netherrealm. This later-primary evidence is used to confirm formal revenant state without rewriting the earlier MK9 death/soul-control scenes.
